releaseNotes: Bottom navigation now switches immediately with Telegram-style horizontal page slides; Settings is pre-mounted and no longer flashes the previous page.
Android keyboard resizing is stabilized so the message composer stays attached to the keyboard and returns to the bottom safe area consistently.
Swipe a message left to reply, with a native spring gesture and haptic feedback.
Chat previews update immediately for sent, forwarded, queued and realtime messages without duplicate optimistic entries.
Authenticated images now open inside Snezhok instead of redirecting to a broken external media link.
The attachment sheet now defaults to compressed photo/video, with HQ and Original File under the overflow menu.
Uploads display real circular transfer progress from 0 to 100 percent and media processing safely falls back to the original file if optimization fails.
